summary: Full Stack Developer will play a key role in building and enhancing a scalable, use-case-agnostic IoT cloud platform.
responsibilities: Collaborate with Product Owners and Tech Leads to understand feature requirements and user journeys.
Analyze functional scope, technical feasibility, system integration points, and device/cloud data interaction patterns.
required_skills: 3–7 years of experience in full-stack application development using Node.js and React (TypeScript preferred).
Hands-on experience working with Azure cloud services (e.g., Event Grid, Function Apps, Cosmos DB, Redis Cache, ADLS).
nice_to_have_skills: Familiarity with common IoT communication protocols such as MQTT and LoRa.
Practical experience with REST API design, microservices, event-driven architecture, and async communication.
benefits: Ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and improve application performance and reliability.
Strong understanding of secure coding practices, identity & access control, and data protection.
